title: DR-9: label helpers take Label without the 'MLS 1.0 ' prefix
description: RFC 9420 §5.1.2-5.1.3: SignWithLabel/EncryptWithLabel prepend 'MLS 1.0 ' to Label. mimi_mls::label takes the bare Label (&str) and adds the prefix, matching the RFC's wording, openmls SignContent::new, and the mlswg crypto-basics vectors. Verify/decrypt failures carry no cause by design (no oracle detail to callers).
